hook: Boryl groups range from strong electron donors to strong acceptors, a new Hammett scale shows.
summary: The authors measured how boryl groups change the acidity of substituted benzoic acids and filled gaps with calculations to build a set of Hammett constants. Borates donate electrons strongly, while dihaloboranes withdraw them strongly. Some values are computed rather than measured.
title: A Quantitative Map of Boryl Substituent Effects Through Hammett Parameters and Electronic Analysis.
